name: Shop
mood: Clean commerce discovery with white and cool-mist surfaces, big rounded product cards, GT Standard typography, pill search, literal product photography, and one vivid violet action color.

inkBlack.role: Primary text, nav labels, product names, and high-contrast UI.

carbon.role: Literal icon fills, app-store badges, and deep graphic marks only.

graphite.role: Body copy, merchant details, helper text, and secondary labels.

ash.role: Tertiary metadata, inactive nav, muted labels, and captions.

hairline.role: Dividers, subtle card outlines, and input borders.

softGray.role: Secondary card surfaces and product placeholders.

productMist.role: Product grid cards and image wells.

mistBlue.role: Hero background bands, search containers, and pale commerce sections.

pureWhite.role: Page canvas, cards, overlays, and text on dark graphic marks.

shopViolet.role: Primary search action, active states, and focused ecommerce controls.

checkoutGreen.role: Payment success, trusted checkout marks, and positive status only.

rules: Use GTStandard-MRegular-style type for the full interface.
Use weight 400 for most display, body, product, nav, and metadata text.
Use weight 600 only for short UI emphasis.
Use slight negative tracking for display and product names.
Use slight positive tracking for micro labels.

components.name: Violet Search Button
components.recipe: Shop Violet fill, Pure White icon/text, 9999px radius, square or pill shape, GTStandard 14px to 16px.

components.name: Search Bar
components.recipe: Pure White fill, 9999px radius, subtle Hairline border or floating search shadow, left icon, Graphite placeholder, violet submit control.

components.name: Category Pill
components.recipe: Pure White or Product Mist fill, Ink Black text, 9999px radius, 12px by 20px padding, 14px text.

components.name: Product Card
components.recipe: Product Mist or Soft Gray fill, 28px radius, product image centered or full-bleed, product name, merchant, price metadata.

components.name: Merchant Badge
components.recipe: Small circular logo, 32px to 48px, white or brand asset inside product cards.

components.name: App Store Badge
components.recipe: Carbon or Ink Black rounded badge with white platform text and icon.

components.name: Feature Tile
components.recipe: Pure White or Mist Blue surface, 20px radius, 20px to 28px padding, Ink Black heading, Graphite body, screenshot or icon.

components.name: Product Grid
components.recipe: Three-up or four-up grid with wide gutters, 28px card radius, and consistent image wells.

components.name: Mobile App Mockup
components.recipe: Phone frame or app screen stack showing product feed, checkout, or tracking with violet controls.

components.name: Header Nav
components.recipe: White or Mist Blue header, Shop wordmark left, compact nav links, optional app-store/download CTA, no heavy border.

components.name: Trust Row
components.recipe: Merchant logos, payment marks, or app stats in Ink Black and Ash; green only for verified checkout copy.

components.name: Promo Band
components.recipe: Mist Blue background, large GT Standard heading, product imagery, and a single violet or black pill action.

do: Use Pure White or Mist Blue as page and section backgrounds.
Use Shop Violet for the primary search or action control.
Use Checkout Green only for trust, checkout, and payment success.
Use product photography as the main visual asset.
Use 9999px radius for search, category pills, and CTAs.
Keep product metadata compact and muted.
Use flat product cards by default.
dont: Do not add a second accent color.
Do not use violet for broad backgrounds or large cards.
Do not use green for ordinary CTAs.
Do not use sharp square product cards.
Do not use heavy shadows on all cards.
Do not replace product photography with abstract graphics.
Do not make the page feel like enterprise SaaS.
